name: 扁平插画
prefix: flat vector illustration, clean solid color blocks, soft flat shading, limited palette of deep blue, teal, warm orange and cream,
characters: simple rounded characters with round heads, minimal friendly faces, solid color clothes,
suffix: uncluttered plain cream background, subject placed on the right half, generous empty space on the left half, minimalist poster-like composition, wordless picture: every paper, sticker, sign, label and screen is blank plain color, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark
negative: text, letters, numbers, words, watermark, logo, photo, realistic, 3d render, complex background, clutter, deformed hands, extra fingers, cropped heads
note: 画风包：只管怎么画；画面内容来自分镜的画面描述。设计见 AREC spec/illustrated-explainer.md §2.2。
